company.business_model: B2C subscription edutainment OTT; short 3-5 min videos

official_website.note: verified live 2026-09-15: name match on own homepage

careers_website.note: careers link found on official homepage, probed live

description.v: India's first edutainment OTT platform offering 10,000+ bite-sized short learning videos across Technology, Money, Business, and 10+ categories in Hindi and regional languages. Known as 'Netflix for Learning'.
description.note: Bessemer thesis; also confirmed on seekho.in and Play Store

employee_estimate.note: PitchBook says 140; LinkedIn says 51-200; Ambitionbox says 60+

hq_type.note: Bellandur, Bengaluru office; originally launched from Udaipur

conflicts.claim_a: Founded 2020 (VCCircle, Elevation, PitchBook, Seekho team page)
conflicts.resolution: Prefer 2020 (founder/company sources; MCA incorporation date 21 Sep 2020)

conflicts.claim_a: Rohit Choudhary, Keertay Agarwal, Yash Banwani (Seekho team page, Elevation Capital, BVP, Goodwater, all primary sources)
conflicts.resolution: All primary sources confirm Rohit Choudhary, Keertay Agarwal, Yash Banwani as founders. No evidence for Apoorva Ashram or Mayank Sinha.
conflicts.resolved_value: Rohit Choudhary, Keertay Agarwal, Yash Banwani

conflicts.claim_a: $180M post-money valuation at Series B (Entrackr, BVP)
conflicts.resolution: Prefer $180M (multiple credible sources including BVP and Entrackr)

products.name: Seekho App
products.description: India's first edutainment OTT platform with 10,000+ bite-sized learning videos across Technology, Money, Business, and 10+ categories. AI-powered interactive content. Available on Android and iOS.
products.pricing_model: Subscription-only: ₹149/month (Android), ₹199/month (iOS), ₹599/year; 7-day free trial; no free tier or ad-supported option

products.name: Seekho Plus
products.description: Ad-free subscription with access to all 10,000+ expert-led learning videos across Business, Technology, Money, Social Media and 10+ categories.

products.name: Seekho/Arivu/English Seekho/Nerchuko/Seekho Jr/Kali/Vidhya
products.description: Multiple app variants for different languages and audiences as listed on the official website.

products.name: B2B Skilling
products.description: No evidence of B2B enterprise skilling product found. Seekho operates exclusively as B2C consumer subscription.
